# 042-project-management-features-expansion

**Priority:** Medium

**Description:** Expand project management with pagination, advanced filtering, and search capabilities.

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] Add pagination methods (getProjectsPaginated) to project repository
- [ ] Implement advanced filtering by status, date range, priority, and tags
- [ ] Add search/filtering capabilities to project views
- [ ] Implement efficient single project fetch methods
- [ ] Update project_providers.dart with new filtering parameters
- [ ] Add fuzzy search implementation for project name, description, and tags
